title: Unique normalized completed integral second slot shift
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an arbitrary scheme W and an integer r. There exists exactly one natural isomorphism moving the shift r in the completed integral second slot to a shift of the tensor output, satisfying integralCompletedTensorRightShiftProperty of [lem-sf-completed-tensor-shift-right]. The normalization is required on every resolving pair, with no condition that l be invertible on W. Uniqueness is equality of the natural isomorphisms, not merely existence of an isomorphism between their endpoints.

proof.text: Use integralCompletedTensorFiniteShift for the signed strict tower comparison. Apply the already proved goodShift, goodInputShiftIso and goodOutputShiftIso construction helpers of CompletedTensorShiftRight. The generic descendShift lemma applies via completedTensorUniversal. All these helpers are stated for arbitrary schemes, so this constructs the completed right comparison without the unused geometric invertibility binder of the existing public theorem. Unfold their component equations to obtain integralCompletedTensorRightShiftProperty. Finally combine this existence witness with the new extensionality theorem, which identifies every other normalized comparison with it.
